title: [main] NO SAF-T changes imported category identifier casing and does not show full identifiers in mapping setup
summary: Norwegian SAF-T now preserves original category identifiers during import and displays them in the mapping setup to prevent uppercase conversion issues and improve identifier visibility.
key_points: Original category identifier now stored for all imported categories, not only those over 20 characters
New read-only Category Extended No. column on the SAF-T G/L Mapping Subpage shows the full identifier
Value refreshes when a category is selected or cleared
Existing category keys and mappings unchanged; reimport source files and regenerate the export to repair short categories
Import, mapping page and XML export tests updated and extended
quote: Preserve the original identifier for all imported categories and show it in a read-only Category Extended No. column.
